ExtraDock 4.2.2 – Rock-Solid Menus & Smarter Spaces! 🛠️✨

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • Lock Position Restored: The "Lock Position" option for floating docks is back in the right-click menu — it was accidentally removed during the previous UI redesign. Your docks stay exactly where you put them!
  • Menu Icons Restored: Right-click menu items now display their icons again — another casualty of the UI redesign that's been fully restored. Your menus look sharp and complete once more!
  • Smarter Respect Dock Area: The "Respect Dock Area" feature now properly reacts to switching Spaces, activating apps, and restoring minimized windows. Previously these scenarios were missed — now your windows respect your dock boundaries in every situation!
  • ExtraDock Respects Itself: ExtraDock's own screens (Main UI and Settings) now properly respect ExtraDock dock areas, so they no longer overlap your docks.

⚡ What's Improved

  • Seamless DockFlow Sync: DockFlow integration now automatically stays in sync when you add, remove, show, hide, or reconfigure docks — no manual refresh needed. Everything just works!

🚀 What's Next?

We're continuing to refine and polish ExtraDock based on your feedback. More customization, better stability, and exciting new features are on the way. Keep sharing your ideas — you're shaping the future of ExtraDock!

Thank you to the amazing ExtraDock community for your continued support. Every suggestion and bug report helps us build a better dock experience!

Want even more control over your workspace? Check out DockFlow to manage dock presets and create the perfect setup for every task!

And ExtraBar to create the ultimate menu bar that fits your workflow!
